claims.claim: Gearbox for Ford Econoline E150/E250/E350 V8
claims.evidence: No VIN, part number, or casting marks visible in any photo to confirm vehicle fitment.
Origin/import paperwork or shipping tags not visible in photos; dirt/grime consistent with yard storage, not proof of origin.
No start-up video, compression test, or audio clip provided; photos are static and show only exterior grime.
No odometer, service sticker, or internal wear shot; mileage cannot be read from exterior photos.
No close-up of bolt heads/seals showing untouched torque marks or factory seals; dirt coverage could hide prior resealing.

risks.risk: Engine/transmission may not actually be the stated Ford V8 Econoline unit
risks.proof: Clear photo of casting numbers, engine ID tag, or transmission plate
risks.if_unproven: price as unidentified generic used engine-transmission assembly, not as confirmed Ford V8 fitment

risks.risk: Internal mechanical condition (pistons, bearings, timing components) unknown
risks.proof: Video of engine running/idling with sound, plus compression test readout

risks.risk: Fluid leaks (oil, coolant, transmission fluid) not visible due to dirt
risks.proof: Close-up photos of gasket seams, pan, and seals after cleaning, or a short video showing no drips when running

risks.risk: Missing or non-functional wiring harness, sensors, ECU, starter/alternator
risks.proof: Full-length photo of wiring harness and labeled accessory shot
risks.if_unproven: price as incomplete assembly requiring additional parts

risks.risk: Transmission type and internal condition (manual/auto, clutch/torque converter wear)
risks.proof: Photo of transmission tag/ID plus video of shifting through gears if possible
risks.if_unproven: price as unknown-condition transmission, worst case needing rebuild

risks.risk: Mileage/usage history cannot be confirmed, affecting wear assumptions
risks.proof: Odometer photo from donor vehicle or any service record paperwork

proof_requests: Close-up of engine ID tag/casting number and transmission plate
Video of engine starting and idling with audible sound
Compression test results or photo of gauge readings
Close-up of all seams/gaskets after wiping dirt to check for leaks
Full shot of wiring harness, sensors, starter and alternator included
Any donor vehicle odometer photo or import/customs paperwork
response.reason: The witness confirms this is a used engine-transmission assembly, so it can be priced at worst case as an unverified, unidentified-fitment, condition-unknown core; all seller claims about model fit, origin, mileage, and working condition remain unverifiable or unverified from the photos alone.
